def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # gather markers per color (non-background: most common color)
    import collections
    bg=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    cols=collections.defaultdict(list)
    rows_=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in pts: cols[j].append((i,c)); rows_[i].append((j,c))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j,arr in cols.items():
        arr.sort()
        for k in range(len(arr)-1):
            a,b=arr[k],arr[k+1]
            if b[1]==a[1] and not any(g[i][j]!=bg for i in range(a[0]+1,b[0])):
                for i in range(a[0]+1,b[0]): out[i][j]=2
    for i,arr in rows_.items():
        arr.sort()
        for k in range(len(arr)-1):
            a,b=arr[k],arr[k+1]
            if b[1]==a[1] and not any(g[i][j]!=bg for j in range(a[1]+1,b[1])):
                for j in range(a[1]+1,b[1]): out[i][j]=2
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Rule attempt: a background cell becomes 2 if scanning its row it lies between two same-colored cells
# AND scanning its column similarly, i.e. "enclosed" between matching markers on both axes? Check demos.
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    import collections
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    mc=min(cnt,key=cnt.get)  # rarest color(s)
    out=[r_[:] for r_ in g]
    def bet(a,b): return a<b and b>a
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=mc: continue
            row=g[i]; col=[g[r_][j] for r_ in range(h)]
            # left/right same color
            lr=any(row[c]==mc for c in range(j)); rr=any(row[c]==mc for c in range(j+1,w))
            up=any(col[r_]==mc for r_ in range(i)); dn=any(col[r_]==mc for r_ in range(i+1,h))

# Collect stats: for each demo, classify fills into "bbox ring", "row-gap<=k", "col-gap<=k", "both"
def classify(n):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    mc=collections.Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    mc=min(mc,key=mc.get)
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc]
    rmin=min(p[0] for p in pts); rmax=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    cmin=min(p[1] for p in pts); cmax=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    # gather all bg-to-2 cells with feature set: gap size along row, along col, on ring
    feats={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=mc and o[i][j]==2:
                rowmk=[jj for jj in range(w) if g[i][jj]==mc]
                colmk=[rr for rr in range(h) if g[rr][j]==mc]
                onring=(i in(rmin,rmax)) or (j in(cmin,cmax))
                # smallest gap in row
                rg=min(abs(j-x) for x in rowmk)-0  # placeholder
                rf=None
                # find nearest markers
                lr=[x for x in rowmk if x<j]; rr_=None
                rl=[x for x in rowmk if x>j]
                lf=-1; rf=-1
                if lr: lf=max(lr)
                if rl: rf=min(rl)
                uc=[x for x in colmk if x<i]; dc=[x for x in colmk if x>i]
                ub=-1; db=-1
                if uc: ub=max(uc)
                if dc: db=min(dc)
                key=(onring, 'rg=%d'%max(0,(rf-lf-1)) if lf>-1 and rf>-1 else None, 'cg=%d'%max(0,(db-ub-1)) if ub>-1 and db>-1 else None)
                feats.setdefault(key,[]).append((n,i,j))
    return feats
F=collections.defaultdict(list)
for n in range(1,9):
    feats=classify(n)
    for k,v in feats.items(): F[k].extend(v)
print(len(F))

import collections
# Tabulate features for EVERY background cell across all demos: label = became 2 ? 
def feats(g,o):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    mc=min(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc]
    rmin=min(p[0] for p in pts); rmax=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    cmin=min(p[1] for p in pts); cmax=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    def flank(mklist,pos):
        L=[x for x in mklist if x<pos]; R=[x for x in mklist if x>pos]
        return max(L,default=None), min(R,default=None)
    F=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=mc: continue
            RM=[c for c in range(w) if g[i][c]==mc]
            CM=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][j]==mc]
            L,R_=flank(RM,j); U,D_=flank(CM,i)
            LG=-1 if L is None else j-L-1
            RG=-1 if R_ is None else R_-j-1
            UG=-1 if U is None else i-U-1

import collections
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # horizontal runs with exactly ONE bg gap between two same-colored markers -> fill
    for i in range(H):
        cs=[j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            if all(g[i][k]==bg for k in range(a+1,b)) and g[i][a]==g[i][b]:
                for k in range(a+1,b): out[i][k]=g[i][a]
    return out
for n in [7,5,4,6,8,2]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    r=solve(gi)
    print(n,'match' if r==go else f'mism={sum(1 for i in range(len(r)) for j in range(len(r[0])) if r[i][j]!=go[i][j])}')

                if ok and g[i][a]==g[i][b]:
                    c=g[i][a]

                    while k<W and g[i][k]==bg: k+=1
                    if k==W or g[i][k]==c:
